fragments.locator: Verify that Authorization Checks are Performed in the Right Location
fragments.excerpt: Developers must never rely on client-side access control checks.

fragments.locator: Validate the Permissions on Every Request
fragments.excerpt: Permission should be validated correctly on every request, regardless of whether the request was initiated by an AJAX script, server-side, or any other source.

fragments.locator: Cross-validation: evaluating estimator performance; opening paragraph
fragments.excerpt: Learning the parameters of a prediction function and testing it on the same data is a methodological mistake: a model that would just repeat the labels of the samples that it has just seen would have a perfect score but would fail to predict anything useful on yet-unseen data.
